# Launch Checklist (title 1)

## T-8 weeks
- [ ] Name, domain, Instagram/Facebook/TikTok/WhatsApp handles secured
- [ ] Ltd company, ICO registration (£52/yr), privacy policy, PECR-compliant signup (double opt-in, consent log)
- [ ] Sending domain: SPF, DKIM, DMARC (p=quarantine), BIMI later; warm-up plan
- [ ] Platform decision (see SEO doc) and archive site live with Impressum-equivalent "About/Contact"
- [ ] Style guide v1 (voice, banned words, section rules, Pressekodex-style crime rules)
- [ ] Source list wired: Wandsworth + Lambeth council news/planning RSS, Met Police local, TfL, BPS events, venue sites, Eventbrite/DICE/Skiddle, Reddit, Nextdoor, local FB groups (manual), Instagram hashtags

## T-6 weeks
- [ ] Founding partner outreach: The Junction BID, Clapham Business Community BID, 3 estate agencies, 2 hospitality groups
- [ ] Prospect list: Google Places scrape, 1,500+ Ltd businesses, enrich, segment
- [ ] Landing page with "coming soon" + referral waitlist; 300 seed subscribers from own network, residents' societies, mums' groups

## T-4 weeks
- [ ] 6 test issues drafted and sent to 30 friendly readers; measure opens/clicks; fix voice
- [ ] Instagram: 20 posts banked (openings, maps, "did you know", polls); handle live
- [ ] Events calendar seeded with 60+ events; organiser submission form live
- [ ] Directory seeded (OSM + Places) for SW11/SW4/SW8/SW12: 1,000+ pages, noindex until enriched

## Launch week
- [ ] Issue 1 Monday 06:30; press note to Press Gazette / HTFP / Behind Local News (they cover launches)
- [ ] Posts in every relevant FB group and Nextdoor; printed cards to 40 cafés and estate agents
- [ ] Welcome sequence (3 emails): who we are, best-of, refer a neighbour

## Month 1 to 3
- [ ] Weekly KPI review: subs, opens, clicks, unsubs, referral share, sponsor pipeline
- [ ] Rate card published at 2,000 subs; self-serve classifieds live
- [ ] Membership tier launched at month 3 with founding-member price
